sequence.description: Bryce Eldridge singles on a fly ball to left fielder Jase Bowen.
Jung Hoo Lee grounds into a force out, first baseman Ty France to shortstop Xander Bogaerts. Bryce Eldridge out at 2nd. Jung Hoo Lee to 1st.
Fernando Tatis Jr. strikes out swinging.
Jake Cronenworth strikes out on a foul tip.
Ty France singles on a ground ball to left fielder Heliot Ramos. Manny Machado to 2nd.
Jackson Merrill doubles (18) on a line drive to left fielder Heliot Ramos. Manny Machado scores. Ty France scores.
Xander Bogaerts grounds out, second baseman Osleivis Basabe to first baseman Rafael Devers.
